description: ANCHORAGE, AK — Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska) has delivered significant wins for the Juneau community, from responding to devastating glacial flooding, supporting local schools, improving infrastructure, and strengthening the Coast Guard’s resources. → Responding to Juneau’s Glacial Flooding: Following the recent and devastating annual floods, Senator Sullivan visited with homeowners and worked with local leaders […]
